description: The complete source for one component and every file it imports, ready to save at the paths given. Free components need a free Layro account's token; Pro components need the caller's Layro lifetime access. Install with the shadcn CLI instead when you can run commands (see get_installation).

include_dependencies.description: Also return every file it imports (the theme, foundations, sibling components). Default true. Set false only if those are already in the project.

name: get_component_code
title: Get a Layro component's code
